faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What architecture services do you provide in Rajokri?

Planning, elevations, working drawings and consultant coordination for farmhouses, independent houses, commercial buildings and event spaces.

Can you design a farmhouse from the ground up?

Yes. We plan the main house, guest areas, lawns, driveways and service blocks so the whole property works together.

Do you plan for privacy on large plots?

Yes. Building placement, boundary design and landscaping are planned to keep private areas away from roads and neighbours.

Why choose architecture services and interiors together?

Designing both at once means windows, ceilings, lighting and furniture are planned as one, with fewer changes during construction.
